# Program User stories

**Program User:** The Compass program office. Covers the whole program.

<a id="req-program-web-0001"></a>

### Program menu and Home page

`REQ-PROGRAM-WEB-0001` · first slice

- **Who:** Program User
- **What:** The Program menu lists a Program User's screens, and Home is the page they land on.
- **Why:** Each persona gets its own view *(PLT-1: RBAC: unit (buyer), agency (supplier), corporate/program owner)*
- **Sources:** [PRD](https://instawork.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ec/pages/4841898227/Compass+VMS+Product+Requirements) Pages; [PRD](https://instawork.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ec/pages/4841898227/Compass+VMS+Product+Requirements) §1 Dashboard / Profile; [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) PLT-1

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** The Program User menu lists Home, Shifts, Workers, Rates, Credentials, Agencies, Org, Users, Reports, Uploads, and Settings, in that order.
- **R11.** Home is the page a Program User lands on, first in the menu; it holds only the sections other requirements add, and says there is nothing to do when none has anything to show.

**Open questions it rests on**

- [D-65](open-questions.md#d-65) Which screens does a Program User have?
- [D-107](open-questions.md#d-107) How can the first slice be used before every screen and feature exists?

<a id="req-program-web-0002"></a>

### Manage the org tree, Units, and Departments

`REQ-PROGRAM-WEB-0002` · first slice

- **Who:** Program User
- **What:** On the Org screen a Program User browses the Compass org as a tree and adds, changes, and deactivates Sectors, Regions, Districts, Units, and Departments.
- **Why:** Spend must roll up the Compass structure *(PLT-2: Org hierarchy: sector → region → district → unit → department, with cost centers)*
- **Sources:** [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) 7.1; [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) PLT-2; [Demo sessions](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Xy3QVWr-aVVV6mpMxWsH6kb987IzwVPXDQ1iW8k83Bo/edit) Shift Creation

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** The Org screen shows the org as a tree of Sectors, Regions, Districts, and Units, each node with its name and whether it is active.
- **R2.** A Program User adds a Sector, a Region under a Sector, or a District under a Region, and renames, deactivates, or reactivates one, each through [`REQ-ORG-0008`](business-rules.md#req-org-0008).
- **R3.** Deactivate is offered on a Sector, Region, or District only when every node beneath it is inactive.
- **R4.** Add Unit, offered under an active District, takes a name, address line, city, state, ZIP code, Company, Work Week start day, optional time zone, and at least one Department, and saves through [`REQ-ORG-0002`](business-rules.md#req-org-0002).
- **R5.** The Unit form also takes whether the Unit is a secured site and its default parking, entrance, directions, site contact, and attire.
- **R6.** A saved Unit's page shows the Market and the time zone Iris set from its ZIP code.
- **R7.** A Unit's page lists its Departments with their cost center codes, addresses, and whether active, and the Program User adds, renames, or deactivates one through [`REQ-ORG-0002`](business-rules.md#req-org-0002).
- **R8.** The Program User can change any field of a Unit and deactivate it through [`REQ-ORG-0002`](business-rules.md#req-org-0002), and an inactive Unit is marked as taking no new Request.
- **R9.** Adding a Department starts its address and five site instructions from the Unit, and the Program User can change them.
- **R10.** A Unit's page shows its account team from [`REQ-ORG-0011`](business-rules.md#req-org-0011) and its primary operator, picked through [`REQ-ORG-0002`](business-rules.md#req-org-0002) from the active Unit Users whose grants cover the Unit.

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-ORG-0001` Hold the Compass org tree](business-rules.md#req-org-0001)
- [`REQ-ORG-0002` Add a Unit and its Departments](business-rules.md#req-org-0002)
- [`REQ-ORG-0008` Add Sectors, Regions, and Districts by hand](business-rules.md#req-org-0008)
- [`REQ-CATALOG-0002` Hold Markets and their ZIP codes](business-rules.md#req-catalog-0002)
- [`REQ-ORG-0009` Allow each action only to its role and scope](business-rules.md#req-org-0009)
- [`REQ-ORG-0011` Assign Instawork's account team to parts of the org](business-rules.md#req-org-0011)

<a id="req-program-web-0003"></a>

### List every Agency's Rate Lines and enter rates

`REQ-PROGRAM-WEB-0003` · first slice

- **Who:** Program User
- **What:** On the Rates screen a Program User filters every Agency's Rate Lines by Position and Market. They enter, change, and end lines for any Agency, and read the rate history.
- **Why:**
  - About 200K rates sit in spreadsheets with known inaccuracies *(RC-3: Structured rate card by position, market and vendor, replacing the master spreadsheet)*
  - Know who changed a rate, when and why *(RC-5: Rate change audit trail)*
  - Raised; pending a Foodbuy decision *(RC-6: Unit as an additional rate card dimension (position + market + vendor + unit))*
- **Sources:** [Demo feedback](https://docs.google.com/document/d/14AQi9DSbYzvEEijmSjCUajHHymowKWYXTPcO3hDEkWc/edit) A lot of vendors side by side; [Demo feedback](https://docs.google.com/document/d/14AQi9DSbYzvEEijmSjCUajHHymowKWYXTPcO3hDEkWc/edit) Rate Cards needs to be its own CRM; [Demo sessions](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Xy3QVWr-aVVV6mpMxWsH6kb987IzwVPXDQ1iW8k83Bo/edit) Rate Cards & Supplier Sourcing

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** The Rates screen lists Rate Lines across all Agencies, one row per line, with Agency, Position, Market or Unit, the six rates, Markup as a percentage, effective dates, and status.
- **R2.** It filters by Market, Position, Agency, Unit, and status and sorts by any rate, rather than placing Agencies side by side (C-15).
- **R3.** It opens on APPROVED lines in effect today.
- **R7.** Add rate opens the form of [`REQ-RATES-0013`](business-rules.md#req-rates-0013) with an Agency field, and the saved line is listed as APPROVED at once (C-13).
- **R8.** An APPROVED line with no effective_to offers Change, which opens that form filled from the line; saving adds a new APPROVED line through [`REQ-RATES-0009`](business-rules.md#req-rates-0009) that ends the old one on its effective_from.
- **R10.** A History tab lists every line of every Agency, including superseded, PENDING, and SENT_BACK ones, as [`REQ-RATES-0003`](business-rules.md#req-rates-0003) keeps them, and each opens its change history through [`REQ-SHELL-0011`](every-user.md#req-shell-0011), shown to Program Users.
- **R11.** An APPROVED line with no effective_to also offers End, which takes an end date and a reason and saves through [`REQ-RATES-0009.R14`](business-rules.md#req-rates-0009).

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-RATES-0001` Hold each Agency's Rate Card](business-rules.md#req-rates-0001)
- [`REQ-RATES-0003` Keep a history of every rate change](business-rules.md#req-rates-0003)

- [`REQ-CATALOG-0002` Hold Markets and their ZIP codes](business-rules.md#req-catalog-0002)

<a id="req-program-web-0004"></a>

### Manage Credential Types and Credential Requirements

`REQ-PROGRAM-WEB-0004`

- **Who:** Program User
- **What:** On the Credentials screen a Program User defines Credential Types and sets where each is required, by org node, by Position, or by both.
- **Why:** Requirements vary by job, location and event *(WA-13: Certification requirements by region, position, unit and sector (e.g. alcohol service, food handler, TB tests))*
- **Sources:** [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) 3.4; [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) WA-13

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** The Credentials screen has a setup tab that lists Credential Types with name, proof of ATTESTATION or VERIFIED_DOCUMENT, whether they expire, whether active, and how many Credential Requirements name each.
- **R2.** Add type and Edit type take a name, the proof, and whether the type expires, and save through [`REQ-COMPLIANCE-0001`](business-rules.md#req-compliance-0001).
- **R3.** A type offers Deactivate and Reactivate but no delete, and the page says an inactive type stops being required and keeps its Credentials and Attestations.
- **R4.** Credential Requirements are listed with their Credential Type, the org node or every Unit, and the Position or every Position, and filter by each of the three.
- **R5.** Add requirement picks an active Credential Type, an org node from the tree or none, and a Position or none, and saves through [`REQ-COMPLIANCE-0001`](business-rules.md#req-compliance-0001).
- **R6.** Each requirement offers Remove, which deletes it through [`REQ-COMPLIANCE-0001`](business-rules.md#req-compliance-0001).
- **R7.** Before a requirement is added or removed, the page says eligibility is checked again, so Workers already assigned may come off Shifts that have not started.
- **R8.** Picking a Unit and a Position shows every Credential Type a Shift there would require under [`REQ-COMPLIANCE-0001`](business-rules.md#req-compliance-0001).

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-COMPLIANCE-0001` Set Credential Types and where each is required](business-rules.md#req-compliance-0001)
- [`REQ-ORG-0001` Hold the Compass org tree](business-rules.md#req-org-0001)
- [`REQ-CATALOG-0001` Hold the Compass Position catalog](business-rules.md#req-catalog-0001)
- [`REQ-ORG-0009` Allow each action only to its role and scope](business-rules.md#req-org-0009)

<a id="req-program-web-0005"></a>

### See program reports and the data they use

`REQ-PROGRAM-WEB-0005`

- **Who:** Program User
- **What:** On the Reports screen a Program User sees the top Agencies, Events, and Units with trends, the Timesheet compliance report, labor cost as a percentage of sales, and Event costs. They load and check the Budgets and sales data behind them.
- **Why:**
  - Units want to know what last Friday's banquet actually cost, and some clients expect it the next morning *(REP-2: Event-level cost: group shifts into an event and see projected vs. actual, available the next morning)*
  - Managers should see total labor cost as % of sales, not a surprise invoice *(REP-3: Labor cost as a percentage of sales by location, using revenue data)*
  - Labor cost as a % of sales needs revenue data by location *(REP-4: Sales data upload by location)*
  - Spend vs. budget needs budgets in Iris *(REP-8: Unit budgets loaded by bulk upload)*
  - Program owners need trends and supplier performance *(REP-9: Program owner views: top suppliers, events and operators, with trends over time)*
  - VMS requirement: timecard compliance reporting *(REP-10: Timecard compliance report: missed breaks and late approvals)*
- **Sources:** [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) 6.3; [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) 6.1

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** For a period the Program User picks, the Reports screen ranks Agencies, Events, and Units by SPEND, highest first, as [`REQ-REPORTING-0009`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0009) computes them.
- **R2.** Each Agency row shows its FILL_RATE and NO_SHOW_RATE beside its SPEND, and a rate with nothing to divide by shows as not available (C-21).
- **R3.** A trend chart shows SPEND, or another measure the Program User picks, per Work Week or per calendar month across the period.
- **R4.** Every view on the screen can be narrowed to one Sector, Region, or District.
- **R5.** The Timesheet compliance view counts Timesheets with a missed break and late Timesheets for the period, grouped by a dimension the Program User picks from those [`REQ-REPORTING-0002`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0002) lists, as [`REQ-REPORTING-0010`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0010) defines them.
- **R6.** The labor cost view shows LABOR_PCT_OF_SALES from [`REQ-REPORTING-0006`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0006) for each Unit and for the Units together, and not available where no date in the period has revenue.
- **R7.** The Events view lists each Event with its projected cost, its actual cost in the parts [`REQ-REPORTING-0004.R4`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0004) names, the estimated part labelled as an estimate, and the difference.
- **R8.** A data view lists the Budgets and Sales Records loaded, by Unit and date, each with the file it came from.
- **R9.** Upload sales and Upload budgets open the Uploads send step of [`REQ-SHELL-0008`](every-user.md#req-shell-0008) with SALES or BUDGETS picked, and [`REQ-REPORTING-0005`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0005) and [`REQ-REPORTING-0007`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0007) save the accepted rows.
- **R10.** The Reports screen holds the Program User's Saved Reports list from [`REQ-SHELL-0012`](every-user.md#req-shell-0012), and Ask a question opens the assistant of [`REQ-ASSISTANT-0001`](every-user.md#req-assistant-0001), where [`REQ-ASSISTANT-0004`](every-user.md#req-assistant-0004) can save an answer.

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-REPORTING-0004` Show an Event's projected and actual cost the next morning](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0004)
- [`REQ-REPORTING-0005` Upload sales data by Unit](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0005)
- [`REQ-REPORTING-0006` Show labor cost as a percentage of sales](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0006)
- [`REQ-REPORTING-0007` Load Unit budgets from a file](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0007)
- [`REQ-REPORTING-0009` Show Program Users top Agencies, Events, and Units with trends](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0009)
- [`REQ-REPORTING-0010` Report Timesheet compliance: missed breaks and late approvals](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0010)
- [`REQ-ORG-0009` Allow each action only to its role and scope](business-rules.md#req-org-0009)

<a id="req-program-web-0006"></a>

### Manage Agencies and where each is approved

`REQ-PROGRAM-WEB-0006` · first slice

- **Who:** Program User
- **What:** On the Agencies screen a Program User adds Agencies, renames or deactivates them, and approves each one at Sectors, Regions, Districts, or Units.
- **Why:** Non-compliant spend persists through local relationships *(RC-11: Soft or hard gates for off-contract rates and non-contracted vendors)*
- **Sources:** [Demo feedback](https://docs.google.com/document/d/14AQi9DSbYzvEEijmSjCUajHHymowKWYXTPcO3hDEkWc/edit) Creating an agency in bulk; [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) RC-11

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** The Agencies screen lists every Agency with its name, whether it is active, and the number of org nodes it is approved at, and searches by name.
- **R2.** Add Agency takes the Agency's name and a first contact's first name, last name, email, and optional phone, and calls [`REQ-AGENCIES-0001`](business-rules.md#req-agencies-0001), which invites the contact as the first Agency User.
- **R3.** Each Agency offers Rename and Deactivate through [`REQ-AGENCIES-0001`](business-rules.md#req-agencies-0001), and an inactive Agency is marked as receiving no new Release.
- **R4.** An Agency's page lists its approvals with the org node, its level, who approved it, and when, and removed approvals with who removed them and when.
- **R5.** Approve picks a Sector, Region, District, or Unit from the org tree where the Agency has no unremoved approval, and calls [`REQ-AGENCIES-0002`](business-rules.md#req-agencies-0002).
- **R6.** Remove approval calls [`REQ-AGENCIES-0002`](business-rules.md#req-agencies-0002) after the page says that Releases already sent do not change.

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-AGENCIES-0001` Add an Agency](business-rules.md#req-agencies-0001)
- [`REQ-AGENCIES-0002` Approve an Agency for part of the org](business-rules.md#req-agencies-0002)
- [`REQ-ORG-0001` Hold the Compass org tree](business-rules.md#req-org-0001)
- [`REQ-ORG-0009` Allow each action only to its role and scope](business-rules.md#req-org-0009)

<a id="req-program-web-0007"></a>

### Manage Users and their Role Grants

`REQ-PROGRAM-WEB-0007` · first slice

- **Who:** Program User, Instawork Admin
- **What:** On the Users screen a Program User sees every User with their Role Grants, invites Users, grants and revokes roles, and deactivates or reactivates Users, within the limits [`REQ-ORG-0005`](business-rules.md#req-org-0005) sets. An Instawork Admin uses the same screen to invite the first Program User.
- **Why:**
  - Each persona gets its own view *(PLT-1: RBAC: unit (buyer), agency (supplier), corporate/program owner)*
  - MSP task: profile and password management *(PLT-4: User accounts with login, profiles and password management)*
- **Sources:** [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) PLT-1; [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) PLT-4

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** The Users screen lists every User with name, email, phone, whether active, whether the invite was accepted, last sign-in, and each Role Grant's role, scope, and whether it is revoked.
- **R2.** It filters by role, Agency, org node, and active or inactive, and searches by name or email.
- **R3.** Invite takes an email, first name, last name, optional phone, and one role with its scope, and calls [`REQ-ORG-0005`](business-rules.md#req-org-0005).
- **R4.** The role is PROGRAM_USER with no scope, UNIT_USER at an org node picked from the tree, or AGENCY_USER for one Agency; the form offers no INSTAWORK_ADMIN role.
- **R5.** When a UNIT_USER scope is picked, the form says it covers every Unit at or beneath that node.
- **R6.** An existing User offers Add role, and each of their grants offers Revoke, or Restore once revoked, all through [`REQ-ORG-0005`](business-rules.md#req-org-0005).
- **R7.** Send invite again, offered until a User accepts their invite, has [`REQ-IDENTITY-0002`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-identity-0002) email them a new link.
- **R8.** Deactivate and Reactivate call [`REQ-ORG-0005`](business-rules.md#req-org-0005) and are not offered for a User who holds an INSTAWORK_ADMIN grant.
- **R9.** An Instawork Admin sees only the invite form with the role fixed to PROGRAM_USER, which [`REQ-ORG-0005.R6`](business-rules.md#req-org-0005) refuses once a Program User has accepted their invite.

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-ORG-0005` Grant a role within a scope](business-rules.md#req-org-0005)
- [`REQ-ORG-0001` Hold the Compass org tree](business-rules.md#req-org-0001)
- [`REQ-AGENCIES-0001` Add an Agency](business-rules.md#req-agencies-0001)
- [`REQ-ORG-0009` Allow each action only to its role and scope](business-rules.md#req-org-0009)

<a id="req-program-web-0008"></a>

### Change Settings for the program and for parts of the org

`REQ-PROGRAM-WEB-0008`

- **Who:** Program User
- **What:** On the Settings screen a Program User sees every Setting with its program default and its overrides down the org tree, and changes or removes them.
- **Why:**
  - Edits allowed for up to about 3 weeks make reporting stale *(TS-9: Configurable timesheet lock window (e.g. 24–48 hours after an event))*
  - Non-compliant spend persists through local relationships *(RC-11: Soft or hard gates for off-contract rates and non-contracted vendors)*
  - Flag overtime rather than block it; some locations want a hard block, festivals accept overtime *(WA-19: Overtime tracking and alerts within each agency, with an optional hard block per location)*
- **Sources:** [FAQ](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/14WYK18DR1mu3SiXCUTRQw21Zjvzhl91U) Can each sector configure Iris differently?; [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) TS-9; [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) RC-11; [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) WA-19

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** The Settings screen lists every key of the settings catalog with its meaning, its program default, and whether that default is the catalog's or was set by a Program User.
- **R2.** A key the catalog scopes as any lists its overrides, each with its Sector, Region, District, or Unit and its value, and offers Add override at a node picked from the org tree.
- **R3.** PEER_RATE_THRESHOLD_PCT and CREDENTIAL_EXPIRY_WARNING_DAYS are program-wide, so they show a program default only and offer no override.
- **R4.** A value is entered as the key's type, a whole number, on or off, or SOFT or HARD, and saved through [`REQ-ORG-0010`](business-rules.md#req-org-0010).
- **R5.** Remove, offered on an override and on a program default a Program User set, calls [`REQ-ORG-0010`](business-rules.md#req-org-0010), and the screen then shows the value that applies instead.
- **R6.** Picking a Unit shows, for every key, the value in force there as [`REQ-ORG-0006`](business-rules.md#req-org-0006) resolves it.

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-ORG-0010` Change a Setting](business-rules.md#req-org-0010)
- [`REQ-ORG-0006` Resolve a Setting for a Unit](business-rules.md#req-org-0006)

<a id="req-program-web-0009"></a>

### Approve Agency rate changes, show Peer Rates, and follow Rate Reviews

`REQ-PROGRAM-WEB-0009`

- **Who:** Program User
- **What:** On the Rates screen a Program User approves or sends back each Rate Line an Agency submitted. They see each line beside its Peer Rate, send Rate Reviews, and follow each until it is answered.
- **Why:** Units need to see deviations and push back on vendors *(RC-12: Rate review: e.g. when an agency's rates run 15%+ above peer rates, ask the agency to lower the rate or justify it)*
- **Sources:** [Demo sessions](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Xy3QVWr-aVVV6mpMxWsH6kb987IzwVPXDQ1iW8k83Bo/edit) Rate Cards & Supplier Sourcing; [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) RC-12

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** The approval queue, a tab of the Rates screen of [`REQ-PROGRAM-WEB-0003`](#req-program-web-0003), lists PENDING Rate Lines, oldest first, each with its Agency, Position, Market or Unit, six rates, effective_from, and who submitted it.
- **R2.** Each queued line shows the APPROVED line it would replace, when there is one, the change in each rate, and the submitter's change_reason.
- **R3.** A queued Market line also shows the Peer Rate for its Position and Market, when there is one, and whether [`REQ-RATES-0008`](business-rules.md#req-rates-0008) would flag its regular Bill Rate.
- **R4.** Approve calls [`REQ-RATES-0009`](business-rules.md#req-rates-0009), and the line then leaves the queue and shows as APPROVED in the Rate Lines list.
- **R5.** Send back takes a reason and calls [`REQ-RATES-0009`](business-rules.md#req-rates-0009), and the line leaves the queue as SENT_BACK.
- **R6.** A queued line whose effective_from is before that of the APPROVED line it would replace is marked as one that cannot be approved, and offers only Send back.
- **R7.** A Rate Reviews tab lists each review with its Agency, the line, the Peer Rate when it was requested, who requested it, when, and its status.
- **R8.** A KEPT review shows the Agency's reason, and a review answered with a lower line links to that line and shows LOWERED once the line is APPROVED.
- **R9.** Reviews list REQUESTED ones first, then newest first, and filter by status and Agency.
- **R10.** This requirement adds to the Rates screen of [`REQ-PROGRAM-WEB-0003`](#req-program-web-0003) the Peer Rate of each Market Rate Line in effect today, and highlights a line [`REQ-RATES-0008`](business-rules.md#req-rates-0008) flags above it with the gap in dollars and percent.
- **R11.** A line that [`REQ-RATES-0008.R2`](business-rules.md#req-rates-0008) gives no Peer Rate shows none and is never highlighted.
- **R12.** A flagged line with no REQUESTED Rate Review offers Send Rate Review, which calls [`REQ-RATES-0008`](business-rules.md#req-rates-0008), and a line under review shows the review's status instead.
- **R13.** This requirement registers with [`REQ-SHELL-0007`](every-user.md#req-shell-0007), for role PROGRAM_USER, the approval queue for a PENDING RateLine, the History tab of [`REQ-PROGRAM-WEB-0003`](#req-program-web-0003) for any other RateLine, and the Rate Reviews tab for subject RateReview.

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-RATES-0001` Hold each Agency's Rate Card](business-rules.md#req-rates-0001)
- [`REQ-RATES-0008` Ask an Agency to review a rate above its peers](business-rules.md#req-rates-0008)
- [`REQ-RATES-0009` Submit Rate Lines and approve them before they price work](business-rules.md#req-rates-0009)
- [`REQ-AGENCIES-0001` Add an Agency](business-rules.md#req-agencies-0001)

<a id="req-program-web-0010"></a>

### Review Credentials Iris could not settle and audit Attestations

`REQ-PROGRAM-WEB-0010`

- **Who:** Program User
- **What:** On the Credentials screen a Program User decides each Credential that the document checks could not settle. They also audit every Agency's Attestations, including replaced ones.
- **Why:**
  - Fraudulent certificates are a concern *(WA-15: AI document validation: checks expiry, issuer, signs of editing, and public registries where available)*
  - Agencies attest; Compass audits *(WA-16: Attestation records and audit trail for agency-worker compliance (audited by Compass or the MSP))*
- **Sources:** [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) 3.4; [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) WA-15; [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) WA-16

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** The review queue, a tab of the Credentials screen of [`REQ-PROGRAM-WEB-0004`](#req-program-web-0004), lists NEEDS_REVIEW Credentials, oldest upload first, with Worker, Agency, Credential Type, expires_on, and status_reason.
- **R2.** Opening one shows the document, opened under [`REQ-COMPLIANCE-0002.R14`](business-rules.md#req-compliance-0002), beside the issuer, number, issued_on, and expires_on the Agency gave, each check that failed or could not finish, and any verification_reference.
- **R3.** Verify and Reject each take a review_note and call [`REQ-COMPLIANCE-0003`](business-rules.md#req-compliance-0003), and the Credential then leaves the queue.
- **R4.** Before the Program User confirms, the page says the decision is final and cannot be changed later.
- **R5.** An Attestations tab lists every Attestation, including replaced ones, with Worker, Agency, Credential Type, statement, valid_until, who attested, and when, newest first, as [`REQ-COMPLIANCE-0004`](business-rules.md#req-compliance-0004) keeps them.
- **R6.** It marks the latest Attestation of each Worker and Credential Type as current, or as lapsed after its valid_until, and filters by Agency, Worker, and Credential Type.
- **R7.** The Attestations tab offers no way to add, change, or remove an Attestation.

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-COMPLIANCE-0001` Set Credential Types and where each is required](business-rules.md#req-compliance-0001)
- [`REQ-COMPLIANCE-0002` Upload a Credential with its expiry](business-rules.md#req-compliance-0002)
- [`REQ-COMPLIANCE-0003` Validate Credential documents with AI and review what it cannot settle](business-rules.md#req-compliance-0003)
- [`REQ-COMPLIANCE-0004` Record Agency Attestations and keep their history](business-rules.md#req-compliance-0004)

<a id="req-program-web-0011"></a>

### See every Shift, Release, and Timesheet across the program

`REQ-PROGRAM-WEB-0011`

- **Who:** Program User
- **What:** On the Shifts screen a Program User sees every Shift at every Unit, with its Releases, assigned Workers, Timesheets, and rate flags. The screen is read-only.
- **Why:** Units need to see deviations and push back on vendors *(RC-10: Rate variance flags at booking and on approved timesheets, with drill-down (e.g. card $25, paid $29, and why))*
- **Sources:** [PRD](https://instawork.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ec/pages/4841898227/Compass+VMS+Product+Requirements) §2 Shifts; [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) RC-10

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** The Program Shifts screen lists every Shift with its Unit, Position, work date, times, headcount, ASSIGNED count, status, and the Agencies holding its Releases, grouped by work date.
- **R2.** It filters by Sector, Region, District, or Unit, by Agency, by status, and by date range, and opens on Shifts that have not ended, soonest first.
- **R3.** A flags filter keeps Shifts with a Release sent off-contract or to a non-contracted Agency, or with a Timesheet carrying RATE_VARIANCE.
- **R4.** Opening a Shift shows each Release with its Agency, headcount, status, and three Bill Rates, the contracted rate and difference [`REQ-RATES-0006`](business-rules.md#req-rates-0006) reports, any bill_rate_reason, and whether it was non-contracted.
- **R5.** The Shift's page lists each ASSIGNED Worker with their Agency, and each Timesheet with its hours, amount, tips, Expenses, status, exception_reasons, and the rate variance [`REQ-RATES-0006`](business-rules.md#req-rates-0006) reports with the Release's bill_rate_reason.
- **R6.** The screen offers no action: a Program User cannot book, change, send, cancel, staff, or approve anything here.

- [`REQ-DISPATCH-0001` Send a Shift's headcount to a chosen Agency](business-rules.md#req-dispatch-0001)

<a id="req-program-web-0012"></a>

### See every Worker across the program with their Credentials

`REQ-PROGRAM-WEB-0012`

- **Who:** Program User
- **What:** On the Workers screen a Program User sees every Worker of every Agency with the state of their Credentials and Attestations and each Unit's rating. The screen is read-only.
- **Why:** Lapsed certifications shouldn't slip through *(WA-14: Certification upload with expiry tracking)*
- **Sources:** [PRD](https://instawork.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ec/pages/4841898227/Compass+VMS+Product+Requirements) §4 Professionals

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** The Program Workers screen lists every Worker with name, Agency, Positions, and whether active, sorted by Agency and then last name.
- **R2.** Each Worker's row counts their Credentials needing action (REJECTED, expired, or expiring within CREDENTIAL_EXPIRY_WARNING_DAYS, unless a newer one of that type exists) and those in review.
- **R3.** It filters by Agency, by Credential Type, by those two counts, and by active or inactive, and searches by name.
- **R4.** Opening a Worker lists each Credential with its type, expiry, status, status_reason or review_note, and document, and each Attestation, with no upload, attest, or edit action.
- **R5.** A NEEDS_REVIEW Credential there links to the review queue of [`REQ-PROGRAM-WEB-0010`](#req-program-web-0010).
- **R6.** The Worker's page also lists each Unit's rating of the Worker with its review.

<a id="req-program-web-0013"></a>

### Program Home: to-dos and Units ranked by spend

`REQ-PROGRAM-WEB-0013`

- **Who:** Program User
- **What:** A Program User's Home lists their to-dos: Credentials to review, rate changes to approve, and rates above their peers. Its second section ranks every Unit by spend.
- **Why:**
  - Program owners need trends and supplier performance *(REP-9: Program owner views: top suppliers, events and operators, with trends over time)*
  - Units need to see deviations and push back on vendors *(RC-12: Rate review: e.g. when an agency's rates run 15%+ above peer rates, ask the agency to lower the rate or justify it)*
- **Sources:** [PRD](https://instawork.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ec/pages/4841898227/Compass+VMS+Product+Requirements) §1 Compass view; [PRD](https://instawork.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ec/pages/4841898227/Compass+VMS+Product+Requirements) §1 How Todos behave; [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) REP-9

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** Home ([`REQ-PROGRAM-WEB-0001`](#req-program-web-0001)) shows the to-do list of [`REQ-SHELL-0003`](every-user.md#req-shell-0003) with three lines: Credentials to review, rate changes to approve, and rates above their peers.
- **R2.** Credentials to review counts NEEDS_REVIEW Credentials, shows the age of the oldest since it was uploaded, and opens the review queue of [`REQ-PROGRAM-WEB-0010`](#req-program-web-0010).
- **R3.** Rate changes to approve counts PENDING Rate Lines, shows the age of the oldest since it was submitted, and opens the approval queue of [`REQ-PROGRAM-WEB-0009`](#req-program-web-0009).
- **R4.** Rates above their peers counts Rate Lines flagged above the Peer Rate under [`REQ-RATES-0008`](business-rules.md#req-rates-0008) that never had a Rate Review, shows the largest gap in dollars, and opens them on the Rates screen of [`REQ-PROGRAM-WEB-0003`](#req-program-web-0003).
- **R5.** The second section is the Units view, which ranks every Unit by SPEND for the current calendar month, highest first, and shows each Unit's APPROVED_SPEND and PENDING_SPEND.
- **R6.** Each Unit shows this month's SPEND against its normal level as the percentage [`REQ-REPORTING-0009`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0009) computes, with no flag, and shows no comparison where that requirement gives none.
- **R7.** Each Unit also shows how many of its Releases this month were off-contract or non-contracted, as [`REQ-REPORTING-0009.R7`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0009) counts them.
- **R8.** The Units view can be narrowed to one Sector, Region, or District.
- **R9.** Selecting a Unit opens the Program Shifts screen of [`REQ-PROGRAM-WEB-0011`](#req-program-web-0011) filtered to that Unit.
